content: Checkbox inside anchor: click bubbles from checkbox to the <a> and triggers navigation; stopPropagation in the checkbox handler prevents it, but nesting interactive content inside <a> is discouraged by HTML spec (a's content model is transparent, no interactive descendants) and breaks frameworks (Angular issue 11366, React card-in-anchor reports). Clean fix: do not nest — sibling placement (checkbox next to the link inside the row container) or stretched-link pattern. preventDefault on parent click also disables the checkbox toggle itself (SO 15767083) — avoid.
